content.text:
=== Are the 5 modules in profile install list? ===
openculturas_base: NOT in install list
openculturas_discussions: NOT in install list
openculturas_faq: NOT in install list
openculturas_openstreetmap: NOT in install list
openculturas_section: NOT in install list
=== What type are they? (theme vs module) ===
openculturas_base -> profile/themes/openculturas_base/openculturas_base.info.yml :: type: theme
openculturas_discussions -> profile/modules/custom/openculturas_discussions/openculturas_discussions.info.yml :: type: module
openculturas_faq -> profile/modules/custom/openculturas_faq/openculturas_faq.info.yml :: type: module
openculturas_openstreetmap -> profile/modules/custom/openculturas_openstreetmap/openculturas_openstreetmap.info.yml :: type: module
openculturas_section -> profile/modules/custom/openculturas_section/openculturas_section.info.yml :: type: module

observation.command:
cd /workspace && echo "=== Are the 5 modules in profile install list? ==="; for m in openculturas_base openculturas_discussions openculturas_faq openculturas_openstreetmap openculturas_section; do if grep -qE "'${m}:${m}'|^  - '${m}'" profile/openculturas.info.yml; then echo "$m: IN install list"; else echo "$m: NOT in install list"; fi; done
echo "=== What type are they? (theme vs module) ==="
for m in openculturas_base openculturas_discussions openculturas_faq openculturas_openstreetmap openculturas_section; do
  f=$(find profile web -name "${m}.info.yml" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  if [ -n "$f" ]; then t=$(grep -iE "^type:" "$f" || echo "type:(none)"); echo "$m -> $f :: $t"; else echo "$m -> NOT FOUND as .info.yml"; fi
done
